applies_why: This judge text decides whether witnesses for D2 vs C3 count as unanswered and treats them as answered rather than counting them.
quote: the line is cured by retraction, not defended: every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: Phrase: "If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it." Reading 1: mentioning answered verses to reject an unanswered-witness claim is not counting them. Reading 2: any mention of answered verses counts them. I adopt reading 1.
why: The judge text says the witnesses were answered and that the unanswered-witness ground fails, so it does not count them toward a broken link as K-G4 requires.
